locations: Los Angeles, CA; Nashville, TN; New York, NY
aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:864.description: For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer! Position Summary: The Director Ticketing is responsible for overseeing ticket operations, ticket sales, tracking of ticket sales, and the management of show inventory for assigned tours. This position will assess, develop, implement and evaluate new policies and procedures to make ticketing processes more efficient. Additionally, the Director Ticketing will develop and maintain a rapport with the venue and ticketing contacts while monitoring sales, opens, and holds after on-sales. They will also collaborate with artist teams to develop and implement ticketing strategies including pricing strategies. Essential Functions: Oversee ticketing operations for assigned tours, which includes working with venue Box Office personnel to build shows Review and approve events prior to tickets going on sale. Advise on ticket pricing and scaling. Monitor sales, opens and holds after on-sale and up until show day, including updated sold maps and provisions of audits as needed. Review expense reports and vacation requests for ticketing staff. Manage prices of tickets through event day in collaboration with internal revenue management team and artist team Oversee show build for Premium Ticketing department, if applicable, and prepare ticketing information sheet report and send to operations. Manage operation of various ticketing platforms and advise on troubleshooting issues as they arise. Required Qualifications: Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred 8+ years of related work experience, including experience in the entertainment industry and previous management experience Experience in arena and/or stadium ticketing preferred; box office experience a plus Strong knowledge of AXS, Ticketmaster, and other ticketing platforms Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and Adobe Professional Experience working in the music industry, specifically live entertainment Highly organized, detail-oriented, and self-motivated, with the ability to multitask and stay calm in a fast-paced environment Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills Ability to work a flexible schedule, including nights, weekends, and some holidays Payscale: $91,429.17- $140,000.00 Annually Bonus: This position is eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements. Benefits: Full-time: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings. Support SAP HANA environments and related HANA Replication configurations. Analyze system performance, identify infrastructure issues, and implement effective troubleshooting and remediation strategies. Configure and maintain SUSE Manager Server where required. Produce clear and accurate technical documentation covering configurations, procedures, tests, and operational activities. Collaborate with technical stakeholders to ensure infrastructure changes are implemented safely and consistently. Contribute to continuous improvement of SAP infrastructure reliability, availability, and operational processes. Requirements: Proven experience installing, configuring, administering, and upgrading SUSE SLES for SAP environments. Strong hands-on knowledge of HAWK/Pacemaker cluster configuration for high-availability SAP environments. Experience supporting SAP NetWeaver ABAP and Java stacks on SUSE. Knowledge of SAP HANA on SUSE and experience with SAP HANA Replication . Strong troubleshooting, administration, and performance-analysis skills across SUSE Linux Enterprise for SAP environments. Ability to work independently on complex infrastructure challenges while collaborating effectively with project and technical teams. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a methodical approach to diagnosing and resolving technical issues. Good documentation skills and the ability to clearly communicate technical procedures and solutions. Experience configuring or upgrading SUSE Manager Server is considered an advantage. SUSE Certified Engineer (SCE) in SLES for SAP Applications certification is a strong plus. A continuous-learning mindset and willingness to keep developing expertise across SAP infrastructure and related technologies. This is a senior technical leadership opportunity within a high-growth SaaS environment, focused on building and scaling resilient cloud networking infrastructure. You will architect, automate, and support large-scale network solutions across AWS, Azure, and GCP. The role combines hands-on engineering with technical leadership, roadmap development, and service ownership. You will work extensively across Kubernetes networking, firewalls, VPNs, DNS, BGP, and infrastructure as code. Stay current with evolving networking technologies, cloud infrastructure practices, and industry developments, incorporating relevant innovations into the network strategy. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience, with 10+ years of professional engineering experience; experience in an enterprise SaaS environment is highly valued. Deep expertise in enterprise networking, including firewalls, VPNs, DNS, BGP, TCP/IP, TLS, public-cloud networking, VPCs, hybrid routing, and security groups across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP. Proven experience managing and maintaining production Kubernetes environments, with advanced knowledge of Kubernetes networking and CNI implementations; experience with multiple CNI solutions is a plus. Strong understanding of ingress and gateway controller architectures, service discovery, DNS within Kubernetes, and NetworkPolicy functionality. Experience operating across both traditional data center and public-cloud environments, as well as supporting multiple Linux distributions. jobgether-jobgether:lever:effe856c-6b7f-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Business and Management Specialist – Freelance AI Trainer Project based in United Arab Emirates. This freelance opportunity is designed for business and management professionals who want to contribute their expertise to the development of advanced AI systems. You will help evaluate and improve how AI models understand business strategy, organizational behavior, operations, and management decision-making. The work involves challenging models with realistic business scenarios, analytical questions, and strategy-focused exercises. You will assess whether responses are logically sound, practically applicable, and aligned with real-world business practices. Your feedback will help identify reasoning gaps, recurring errors, and situations where AI oversimplifies complex organizational processes. The role combines business expertise, critical thinking, structured evaluation, and clear written communication in a flexible freelance environment. It is an opportunity to turn your knowledge of business and management into training data that helps shape more capable AI systems. Engage advanced AI models using business scenarios, analytical questions, management situations, and strategy-based exercises across areas such as operations, organizational behavior, project management, marketing, entrepreneurship, supply chain, and strategic planning. Evaluate AI-generated responses for logical consistency, business accuracy, practical applicability, and alignment with real-world organizational practices. Identify and document model failure modes, reasoning gaps, oversimplifications, and misunderstandings of business processes. Capture clear, reproducible error traces that can be used to improve model evaluation and training. Provide structured and actionable feedback on prompts, responses, evaluation frameworks, and reasoning quality. Analyze business cases and decision-making frameworks to determine whether AI models can appropriately apply concepts in realistic contexts. Challenge model assumptions and assess how effectively AI handles nuanced business strategy, operational efficiency, market positioning, and organizational decision-making. Clearly articulate your reasoning and decision processes, including the factors that lead to particular business judgments or conclusions. Contribute insights that help improve AI systems designed to support business professionals, organizations, planning, analysis, and decision-making. Requirements Familiarity with business and management concepts, including business operations, management principles, organizational behavior, project management, marketing, entrepreneurship, supply chain fundamentals, or strategic planning. A background in business administration, management, economics, entrepreneurship, or a related discipline is preferred but not required. Professional or academic experience in business operations, startups, corporate environments, consulting, project coordination, or related areas is valuable. Entry-level candidates with strong foundational business knowledge, analytical thinking, and problem-solving abilities are encouraged to apply. Strong critical-thinking skills and the ability to assess whether business decisions, strategies, and processes are logically sound and practically realistic. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex business concepts clearly. Strong metacognitive communication skills, including the ability to explicitly explain your reasoning, assumptions, decision process, and conclusions. Ability to identify inconsistencies, errors, missing context, and unrealistic assumptions in AI-generated business content.
